what_i_see: A thin, gently curved, elongated galaxy ~5" long at centre, orange-red along the body with a bluer extension to the SE end. No compact red galaxy on its concave side.
most_likely: A warped or slightly bent edge-on disc galaxy at z~0.5.
against_it: A lensed arc would usually be bluer and need a deflector; neither is seen.
decisive_test: Spectrum along the arc: a single redshift with disc rotation confirms a warped edge-on galaxy.
catalogue_notes: Legacy DR8 photo-z EXP z=0.46+/-0.18 at 0.84". Gaia G=16.5 star at 24.7" (= nearest NED WISE source, off-frame). No SIMBAD within 30". No match in Jacobs+2019, Huang+2020/2021 (cone 10"; Rojas+2022 query unvalidated).
